issues.jp_before: {土曜日[どようび]|ym-n5-days}は天気[てんき]がいいので、公園[こうえん]へ行[い]きましょう。
issues.problem: Asserts future weather as a plain fact; unnatural as a reason for a suggestion.
issues.action: Changed to 天気がいいそうなので and English to 'I hear the weather will be good on Saturday'.

issues.jp_before: {十二月[じゅうにがつ]|ym-n5-days}は大[おお]きい祭[まつ]りがあります。
issues.problem: Time frame for an existence sentence reads more naturally with には.

issues.jp_before: {日曜日[にちようび]|ym-n5-days}の朝[あさ]は、いつもゆっくり起[お]きます。
issues.problem: English 'get up slowly' mistranslates ゆっくり起きる (get up late / take one's time).
issues.action: English changed to 'I always take my time getting up'.

issues.jp_before: {一日[ついたち]|ym-n5-days}は店[みせ]が休[やす]みです。
issues.problem: 一日は店が休みです can also be read いちにち ('closed for one day'); the sentence does not fix the reading ついたち, and いちにち is a distractor.
issues.action: Rewrote as 店は{一日}から三日まで休みです ('from the first to the third'), which forces ついたち.

issues.jp_before: {七日[なのか]|ym-n5-days}は私[わたし]の誕生日[たんじょうび]です。
issues.problem: Distractor なぬか is an accepted variant reading of 七日.
issues.action: Replaced なぬか with ななか.
